intent.text: I agree with indep and plan's points: cross-family review reduces correlated errors rather than eliminating them, and operational constraints make the review actionable. Because this committee's rules offer 'withdraw' rather than direct motion amendment for makers, I am ready to withdraw the current motion in the next round if someone moves a synthesized replacement, or let this proceed to a vote as everyone already expressed willingness to vote yes on the core principle. To avoid procedural delay, if another member moves an amended text I will happily withdraw; otherwise I support voting on the pending motion.
